`movePreservingContent` intends to bail out when the *destination* is a file (so it can't merge directory contents), but it currently `stat()`s the source instead. If `destination` exists as a file and `source` is a directory, the function will recurse and then fail with ENOTDIR/ENOTEMPTY mid-migration. Consider checking both source and destination types before recursing.

**Preserve `go list` failures when selecting coverage packages.**

If one package cannot be listed, `go list` can omit it while printing other packages. Without `pipefail`, `grep` succeeds and the workflow can upload a passing but incomplete root coverage profile. Enable `pipefail` before this pipeline so package-discovery errors stop the job. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax?utm_source=openai))

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
       - name: Root module (ci.yml unit package set)
         run: |
+          set -o pipefail
           echo "memlock (KiB): $(ulimit -l)"
           pkgs=$(go list ./... | grep -vE '/test/|/adaptive($|/)|/middleware/websocket($|/)')
```
</details>
